statements.statement: The patient presents with paroxysmal palpitations and episodic lightheadedness
There is concern for recurrent supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation
The patient has a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The procedure code billed is CPT 93226
CPT 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service has been rejected because this specific diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is medically necessary to evaluate the cardiac arrhythmia associated with these clinical findings and the transient cerebral ischemic event
